entry.title: Nonna’s Pasta
entry.summary: As my mamma used to say: the best pasta, is home made pasta.
entry.content:
## Ingredients - 3 large eggs - ½ cup of water - 1 kg of all purpose flour - Corn flour for sprinkling the pasta
## Instructions 01. Over a clean surface, spread a little bit of all purpose flour in it. 02. Make a small mountain with the all purpose flour. 03. Create a valley in the middle of the flour mountain and break the eggs inside of it. 04. Knead the dough to mix the flour and eggs, adding water as needed. 05. The dough should be in one single large piece and should not stick too much to your hands nor the surface. 06. If the dough is too sticky, adding more flour will make it be more consistent. 07. If the dough is too dry, adding more water will make it softer. 08. Once the dough is ready, break small pieces or it and open them with a rolling pin. 09. With a knife gently cut the open dough making strands. The pasta strands should not be so thin as they will break. 10. After the pasta is cut, sprinkle the corn flour on the pasta and move them to a large baking pan or other flat surface. 11. Let the pasta dry for 2 hours.

entry.title: Apple Pie
entry.summary: A mix of Italian and German influences makes for a tasty dessert.
entry.content:
## Ingredients - 6 large apples, pealed and sliced - 2 cups of all purpose flour - 1 tbsp of baking powder - 1 cup of brown suggar - ½ cup of margarine - 1 egg - 1 cup of granulated suggar - 2 tbsp of cinnamon
## Instructions 01. Grease and flour a large pan. 02. Place the apple slices in the pan trying to leave no gaps, you may use small apple slices to fill in the gaps. 03. Mix the flour, baking powder, and the brown suggar. 04. Cover the apples with the mixture. 05. Using the back of a spoon carefully smooth the dry ingredients mixture. 06. Soften the margarine until liquid, then carefully pour it on the pan trying not to peel the dry ingredients mixture. 07. Mix the egg yolk and white and pour it on the pan. 08. Mix the cinnamon and the granulated suggarm, then sprinkle it on the pan. 09. Bake at 350 ℉ for about 40 minutes.

entry.title: Francisquito
entry.summary: From Chef Marco’s childhood to your table
entry.content:
## Ingredients - 7 large eggs - 3 and ½ cups of suggar - 1 and ¾ cups of margarine - 1 and ½ tbsp of baking powder - 1kg of all purpose flour
## Instructions 01. Preheat the oven at 450 ℉. 02. In a large bowl mix the eggs, suggar, and margarine. 03. With the tips of the fingers, delicately mix the ingredients in the bowl. 04. Add flour until the dough is still buttery but very firm. 05. Making small horseshoes shaped cookies, lay them in a large baking pan. 06. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

entry.title: Brigadeiro
entry.summary: A classic Brazilian treat, this is the pure definition of "comfort food"
entry.content:
## Ingredients - 1 can of condensed milk - 2 tbsp of cocoa powder - 1 tbsp of margarine
## Instructions 01. In a medium pan mix the condensed milk and cocoa powder. 02. Add the margarine to the pan. 03. Keep stirring over medium heat for it to thicken. 04. When you are able to split the liquid and it takes between 3 to 5 seconds to get back together it is done. 05. Spread over a large dish to cool. 06. Eat once cooled.
